[[File:Citadelswoop.jpg|thumb|250px|Citadel Station swoop racing]]
[[Citadel Station]] was built in [[3955 BBY]] to serve as the living and working quarters of the [[Telosian Restoration Project]]. As of [[3951 BBY]] the '''Citadel Station swoop track''' was considered by many to be state of the art due to its recent construction.<ref name="Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic II: The Sith Lords">''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic II: The Sith Lords]]'': Conversation with [[Telos IV|Telosian]] Race Master.</ref> The circuit was designed to incorporate the new advancements in both [[Swoop racing/Legends|swoop racing]] and the improvements in [[Swoop/Legends|swoop bike]] construction. This was most clearly evidenced by the use of [[Repulsorlift/Legends|repulsorlift]] technology that offered vertical challenges, demanding a high level of skill and precision from the racer.
